messages:
incident-bot: Paging @sre-oncall-maria: Kestrel (single-tenant) is exceeding latency SLOs for the last 4m. p95 = 1.6s (SLO 0.5s), p99 = 5.2s, streaming stalls observed. Error budget at 12%. Auto-escalation triggered. Please acknowledge and triage. 

sre-oncall-maria: acked. pulling metrics and logs now. @dan-engr can you grab runtime traces?

dan-engr: on it. pulling per-route p95/p99, looks concentrated on /v1/streams/generate for tenant kestrel. concurrency spike ~240 reqs/s.

vikram-ml: was Kestrel testing a big longprompt campaign? I see a sudden shift in request length distribution: median tokens -> 800, 95th -> 4k. That could explain KV cache miss storms.

leo-runtime: also seeing many streaming sessions stuck in "writing" state to the client; backend continues to generate but client ACKs delayed. Could be network jitter + backpressure in worker output queues.

sre-oncall-maria: timeline: spike started at 11:03 UTC. Rolling average CPU on dedicated pool "ded-kstl-1" bumped to 98%. Some pods OOM throttled earlier but restarted automatically.

dan-engr: extracting logs snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T11:04:12Z worker-23 WARN kvcache: miss for prefix="<longprompt>" size=4021
2026-03-15T11:04:13Z runtime-io ERROR write: client write timeout after 30s, session=ab12
2026-03-15T11:04:14Z scheduler WARN queue-length=312 model=gpt-open-16b
```

leo-runtime: running `kubectl top pods -n dedicated | grep ded-kstl-1` shows pods near limit; autoscaler didn't kick because minReplicas=6 and targetUtilization maybe mis-configured.

sre-oncall-maria: quick mitigations: 1) increase replica count on ded-kstl-1 to handle burst (if quota allows) 2) enable fallback routing to a smaller quantized variant for streams > 1k tokens 3) throttle per-tenant concurrency if we detect abusive patterns 4) flip prefix-KV caching to aggressive mode for this tenant. Which one is fastest?

dan-engr: fastest is increasing replicas and enabling fallback routing (config patch). KV reconfiguration may need a restart on some workers. I can patch routing now.

leo-runtime: I'll request a quick autoscaler override: `kubectl patch hpa ded-kstl-1 -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":10}}'` — note needs approval if on policy. ops-bot: do we have quota for scaling to 10 pods in this pool?

ops-bot: quota check: ded-kstl-1 pool has 4 spare GPUs in the region, Ops approval required for >8 replicas.

cs-lead-julia: @sre-oncall-maria @dan-engr heads-up: Customer (Kestrel) is on a paid Dedicated plan; they may notice degraded latency. We should craft an initial customer-facing blurb. I'll draft after we stabilize.

sre-oncall-maria: dan, please patch fallback routing. leo, request Ops approval for quick scale. I'll start throttling via rate-limit rule for tenant:kestrel from 240 -> 120 concurrent sessions as temporary measure.

dan-engr: patch applied: routing rule added to route long sessions (>1k tokens) to gpt-open-16b-quantized. Preview of patch: 
```
PATCH /v1/route-config/ded-kstl-1
{ "match": {"tenant":"kestrel","approx_tokens_gt":1000}, "route_to":"gpt-open-16b-quant" }
```
No restart required. Monitoring telemetry now.

leo-runtime: Ops approved emergency scale to 9 replicas (manual override granted). Scaling now.

incident-bot: Action taken: autoscaler override to minReplicas=9 by leo-runtime, routing patch by dan-engr, tenant throttle applied by sre-oncall-maria. Continue monitoring.

sre-oncall-maria: early signal: p95 dropped to 0.9s within 60s, p99 still around 2.2s due to in-flight sessions. Streaming stall counts down from 120 -> 34 in last 3m.

vikram-ml: ML note: fallback quantized model increases latency variance slightly but reduces GPU memory pressure. Check for degradation in output quality; schedule eval run on a held prompt set.

dan-engr: rolling logs show decreased queue length: queue-length=42 now. No new OOM restarts.

cs-lead-julia: drafting message for Kestrel: "We're investigating a latency spike affecting streaming sessions; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with timeline and root cause." Will wait for confirmation to send.

sre-oncall-maria: we should also look for unusual prompt fanout — maybe a multitenant proxy duplicated requests? Run grep for duplicate session IDs and identical prompt hashes.

dan-engr: executed quick check: duplicate session ids < 0.1%. Not a mass fanout. Looks like single-tenant heavy workload with lots of long prompts.

leo-runtime: additional mitigation: disable streaming chunk coalescing temporarily to reduce head-of-line blocking. This is a config flip on the runtime: `runtime.streaming.coalesce=false`. I can flip it on non-critical pods first.

ops-bot: remember to record the change in the incident runbook: /runbook/latency-tail -> append event id 2912345678.

sre-oncall-maria: timeline update for postmortem: started 11:03 UTC, mitigations applied 11:07 UTC, partial improvement 11:08 UTC, stable at 11:12 UTC. Will hand off to night on-call with actions list.

vikram-ml: request to schedule a follow-up: 1) analyze batch token distribution and recommend tenant-specific KV cache sizing 2) evaluate adaptive concurrency limits per token-length 3) open a ticket for prefix caching optimization for sessions >2k tokens.

dan-engr: noted. I'll attach logs and flamegraphs to the ticket.

cs-lead-julia: Sent initial customer note at 11:10 UTC: "We've implemented mitigations to reduce latency and are continuing to monitor; a full update will follow." Customer acknowledged and thanks us for the fast response.

sre-oncall-maria: ok final checklist before handoff: - move routing rule to config repo (PR) - schedule controlled KV cache restart in maintenance window - create customer post-incident note draft - open follow-up engineering tickets - assign to eng-runtime and eng-ml for optimizations

leo-runtime: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/route-config/pull/452 (contains fallback rule).

dan-engr: logs and traces uploaded to incident-kestrel-2912345678 bundle.

sre-oncall-maria: handing off to night on-call @sre-oncall-night with summary + runbook entry. If p99 creeps above 2.5s re-alert and escalate to eng-runtime lead.

ops-bot: incident annotated with tags: [customer:kestrel, impact:streaming-latency, mitigation:fallback-routing, scaled:ded-kstl-1].

incident-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Will auto-close page after 2h if stable.

cs-lead-julia: thanks team. I'll coordinate the customer follow-up and include proposed rate-limits/cost implications.

sre-oncall-maria: closing live triage. Postmortem owners: maria (SRE), dan (runtime), vikram (ML). I'll create the postmortem doc tomorrow. :thumbsup:

dan-engr: thx, great teamwork.
